name: A way for you to see what is going on
summary: An admin area with a navigation menu that only shows what the person signed in is actually allowed to open.

provenance.changes: Written for the Shipyard starter stack.

extensionPoints.description: The admin home page. Put whatever you need to see on it.

postInstall: Add your own pages under src/app/admin/ and list them in navigation.ts with the permission each one needs.
limitations: Hiding a menu item is not security. The page behind it still has to check the permission itself, which is why the guard is a separate function you have to call.
Plain HTML and CSS. No component framework, no charts, no data tables.
